speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Manpower to what extent do persons who are employed and become new citizens in each year affect the determination of the citizen unemployment rate.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Suppose an employed person becomes a citizen, this translates to a 1% growth in the citizen labour force.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: There are now 101 citizens in the labour force, but still only three who are unemployed.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Compared to 3%, the effect is mathematically very small.
